label: Delimiter / start of copy in long sequences (many outputs remaining)
explanation: Fires at the <DEL> step and the first few copy steps, mostly when lots of output is still left to produce (to_go >= 6, so long sequences, L >= 7). Activation is strongest at <DEL> (31% firing rate there, 61% of activation mass), weaker at recall_idx 1 (27% of mass) and recall_idx 2 (10%), then close to zero. Rate rises with to_go (to_go 8: 43%, to_go 7: 29%, to_go 6: 13%) and with L. It essentially never fires in the original-input phase and is rare late in the copy phase. Whether it fires at a given eligible step also depends weakly on token identity (out_tok 3/o/x/v and next_out p/u/r/f have about 3x lift), but no clean token rule was found, so precision stays near 0.47.
